typography.$description: Prose and inline-code styling. Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

code-padding-inline.$description: Inline-code padding is em-adjacent rather than on the spacing scale, so the chip hugs the glyphs at any size.

code-font-size.$description: Inline code is sized relative to the text around it, not fixed on the ramp: Fira Code sets larger than Qeet Text at the same size, and a fixed size would make code in a heading tiny and code in a caption loud.

code-background.$description: Code is a well — the sunken surface role — in both themes, for inline code and for preformatted blocks in Prose alike.
